name: Data Dashboard
oneLiner: Instrument-panel clarity: dense but quiet, tabular numerals, one accent, and status colour that only ever means status.

type.numeric: font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; all metrics, deltas, timestamps, and table cells

effects.row-stripe: transparent — use row hover and dividers instead of zebra stripes

motion.reducedMotion: no counter roll-ups; show the final value immediately

default.base: padding: 16px 20px; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--uiux-color-surface); border: 1px solid var(--uiux-color-border); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(16, 24, 40, 0.06)
default.label: font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--uiux-color-textMuted); letter-spacing: 0.01em
default.value: margin-top: 8px; font-size: 1.75rem; font-weight: 600; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; letter-spacing: -0.02em; line-height: 1.1
default.delta-up: display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; margin-top: 6px; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--uiux-color-success)
default.delta-down: display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; margin-top: 6px; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--uiux-color-danger)

default.base: width: 100%; border-collapse: separate; border-spacing: 0; font-size: 0.875rem; background: var(--uiux-color-surface)
default.header-cell: height: 40px; padding: 0 12px; text-align: left; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--uiux-color-textMuted); background: var(--uiux-color-surfaceAlt); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--uiux-color-border); white-space: nowrap
default.cell: height: 44px; padding: 0 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--uiux-color-border); color: var(--uiux-color-text)

default.base: display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; height: 22px; padding: 0 8px; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; background: var(--uiux-color-surfaceAlt); color: var(--uiux-color-text)
display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; padding: 12px 0
default.input: height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--uiux-color-border); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--uiux-color-surface); color: var(--uiux-color-text); font-size: 0.875rem

primary.base: height: 36px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid var(--uiux-color-accent); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--uiux-color-accent); color: var(--uiux-color-accentText); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500

secondary.base: height: 36px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid var(--uiux-color-border); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--uiux-color-surface); color: var(--uiux-color-text); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500

default.base: position: relative; padding: 16px 16px 8px; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--uiux-color-surface); border: 1px solid var(--uiux-color-border)
default.empty: display: grid; place-items: center; min-height: 220px; color: var(--uiux-color-textMuted); font-size: 0.875rem

do: Right-align numbers and set tabular numerals everywhere so columns line up.
Reserve colour for status and selection; the neutral ramp should carry the entire layout.
Use one accent for interactive affordances and one hue per status, never as decoration.
Show units, time ranges, and comparison baselines next to every metric.
dont: Do not use rainbow categorical palettes without a legend and a colour-blind-safe ordering.
Do not animate numbers rolling for more than 400ms; it delays reading.
Do not use more than two font families or any display face.
Do not let a chart gradient fill imply magnitude beyond the actual line.
antiPatterns: Twelve identical cards with no hierarchy or grouping, forcing a full-page scan.
Red/green deltas without arrows or signs, unusable for 8% of men.
Zebra stripes, hover states, and borders all at once, creating a busy grid that hides the data.

notes: Never encode state by hue alone; pair every status pill with an icon or text label.
Tabular numerals and right alignment are accessibility features for scanning columns, not just polish.
Charts need a text alternative: a summary sentence plus a data table for the same values.
